messages:
Ishani B: Heads up to anyone shipping demo hardware for the Berlin conf  reading airline rules and customs guidance now: spare lithium batteries are a PITA. Has anyone shipped extra batteries before?
Ravi K: Don't check spares. Airlines make you carry spare Li-ion batteries in carry-on only. For shipping, you need specific labeling and sometimes an IATA doc. We shipped a camera kit once and the courier flagged the batteries.
Marta L: We had similar last year. Ops recommended packing batteries in original boxes, tape terminals, and put each in separate zip bags. Also declare on the commercial invoice as "Lithium ion batteries in equipment".
people-ops-bot: FYI: Company travel/shipping policy updated 2025-11-02. For battery shipments, pre-approval required and use approved couriers. See: https://intranet/logistics/shipping-guidelines
Tom C: Quick checklist I used:
```
- Batteries installed in equipment for checked/ship
- Spare batteries carried in cabin with terminals taped
- Items declared on airway bill: UN3481 if packed with equipment
- Courier: FedEx/UPS Hazmat service (pre-clear)
```
Ravi K: Yep UN3481 is the one. If you're mailing from EU to DE, customs might ask for MSDS for large quantities. For a handful of demo spares you should be fine but check with Logistics.
Ishani B: Thanks all. People Ops, is there a preferred courier or a form we should fill before sending demo crates? I can postpone shipping until I have confirmation.
people-ops-bot: Please submit a Shipping Preapproval form at https://intranet/forms/shipping with itemized contents and battery specs (Wh and cell count). Approved couriers list: UPS/FedEx DHL Express Hazmat options. Preapproval turnaround: 48-72h.
Marta L: Also pro tip: mark the box "RETURN  ATTENTION: LOGISTICS" and include a paid return label if you want swag/demo sent back. Saved us customs headache once.
Tom C: Poll: React with 🚨 if you need Ops preapproval for shipment, 📦 if no shipment (carrying all in-cabin), 🔔 if undecided and will DM.
Ravi K: 🚨
Marta L: 📦
Ishani B: 🚨
